answer: Identity mints only by burning a non-refundable bond, and influence scales with the square root of cumulative burn rather than headcount, so splitting one stake into a thousand sock puppets buys a thousandth of the weight and fabrication always costs more than honest work. A comet-seeded verifiable random function then selects which bonds must re-attest each epoch, holding every identity under an unpredictable lantern while staked collateral, the walnut of the system, stays exposed to slashing if the re-attestation fails.
